note: Three separate sites spread over about a mile of Laurel Run Road and Ant Hill Trail, reached over several miles of gravel forest road. Site 082 is an old log landing about 20 m by 15 m on a 200-ft gravel driveway off Laurel Run Road. Site 081 is a larger old log landing (about 35 m by 25 m) on Ant Hill Trail, at the end of a 425-ft gravel driveway the booking page grades 'Moderate'. Site 084 is a grass pull-off beside Laurel Run Road, 75 ft by 30 ft, in full sun, with no built pad. The agency's own campsite layer marks 081 as trailer-accessible and 082 and 084 as not, though the booking pages list all three for trailers up to 25 ft. A picnic table and fire ring at each. No toilet; pack out trash. State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed. --Claude
summary: Keep. All three sites are live and bookable online on ReserveAmerica (availability shown for Nov 2026, May and Jul 2027), each 25 ft max vehicle length, $10 resident / $15 non-resident plus $6.50 reservation fee. Added reservation fee, booking note, pull_through false, facilities; rewrote the note to describe the three sites. Phone should be the district office.
flags: PHONE: stored 888-727-2757 is the ReserveAmerica call centre. The Tuscarora district office is 717-536-3191 (DCNR Tuscarora camping page: 'Contact the Tuscarora State Forest district office at 717-536-3191'; district page shows the same number). apply.py does not write phone.

Criteria, thin (owner's call, no drop proposed): (1) Max Vehicle Length is 25 ft on all three, 2 ft over a 23-ft rig; (2) sites 081 and 084 list categories 'Horse Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site' with no 'RV Site' (082 lists RV Site); (3) site 084 is a 75 x 30 ft grass roadside pull-off ('Pull off along road', Driveway Surface Grass, Length 80) and imagery (leaf-on, canopy) shows only a ~10 m opening beside the road with no distinct pad; (4) the DCNR GIS campsite layer gives TrailerAccess 'Yes' for 081 but 'No' for 082 and 084, contradicting the booking pages. If 084 were dropped for having no pad, count would be 2 (the padless-roadside rule says keep with a caveat, which the note now carries).

Pin: stored 40.23766,-77.54911 is site 082's own GIS point (on its pad, no move). Site 081 is at 40.23438,-77.55870, about 880 m WSW on Ant Hill Trail; site 084 is at 40.24127,-77.54270, about 670 m NE on Laurel Run Road. All within ~1 km of the pin; no split proposed.

Access: OSRM routes in from Newburg over Three Square Hollow Road, Cowpens Road and Laurel Run Road, which OSM tags gravel; several miles unpaved. 081's driveway: 3DEP shows about 5 m of fall over the 175 m of track leaving the pad to the SE (about 3 percent), milder than 'Moderate' suggests. Weight limits or barriers on the way in: UNREAD (Overpass returned 504 / timed out for the 081 area; the 084 query showed Laurel Run Road as unclassified gravel and no limit tag).
Elevation: stored 532 m; USGS 3DEP reads 522 m at the pin (site 082), 538 m at 081, 511 m at 084. apply.py does not write elevation.
Waterfront: no lead (NHD shows nothing within 200 m of any of the three points). 'not waterfront' stands.
